request.subject: CITY:CANDY:2

layers.text: Recolour as a chocolate cake town and change no shape: the pink frosting dripping over the round cake keep becomes dark chocolate glaze #4a2412, over cream sponge; the roofs of the little houses become dark chocolate with white cream piping; the pink gumdrops on the wall become caramel gold #e0a040; doors dark chocolate; the lollipop becomes caramel and cream; one small pink cherry on top of the keep. Keep every shape, the size, outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
